name: Chemical Biology PhD
detailsNote: Official information is available; Fall 2027 dates and an admission model were not explicitly confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall preferred PhD application
publishedDeadlines.note: Central annual date. PhD process page separately labels January 15,2026 for Fall 2026; not a confirmed Fall 2027 date. Rolling review after preferred deadline.

applicationFee.note: Nonrefundable graduate application fee; no applicable waiver verified.

english.note: IELTS 7 or DET 120 avoids ELC coursework. IELTS 6.5/DET 115 may require language course or arrival exam; IELTS speaking/writing 6.5 needed for that exam option. Minimum-score applicants require ELC coursework. Tests valid two years at application review. Documented overseas English-medium bachelor/master or two graduate years can support waiver request but require arrival ECPE. US-degree and listed-country bachelor exemptions differ.

documents: Statement of purpose, 500–1,000 words in 12 pt Times New Roman
Professional writing sample: thesis, research paper or publication
requirements.note: Program requirements list accredited bachelor degree with GPA 3.0, but introductory eligibility wording emphasizes master degrees and contains inconsistent provisional-entry text; confirm bachelor-only eligibility. Unofficial transcripts acceptable for initial review, official copies after admission; non-English records need certified literal translations. GRE optional for Chemical Biology.

funding.note: Limited competitive assistantships/fellowships; no universal award. Tuition/fee coverage varies. Published 2026–2027 TA/RA academic-year stipends: bachelor-entry $28,762; master-entry $30,453; doctoral candidate $32,115, with separate summer eligibility. Good standing and satisfactory progress required; recipients must be in US during funded period.
